3.t: IMPORTANT: The installation of the Merit Qwik Kit requires a Merit. Industries CRT 200 P.C. Board, Rev E-l or later. Your board is a Rev D, Rev C or earlier, contact your distributor or the factory regarding an upgrade. You will find the revision level along the front edge of the board, in front of the connector pins. If the board does not say MERIT INDUSTRIES, it is not a geniune MERIT board, and will not be usable.
